article.title: Индейка для выездного обеда: вспышка после хранения без контроля температуры
article.scope: Полный перевод основной статьи на 2 журнальных страницах: все 6 абзацев расследования, авторы, организации и сведения для переписки. Все 6 библиографических записей сохранены на языке оригинала. В источнике нет отдельной аннотации, рисунков и таблиц. Текст подготовлен по полной HTML-версии CDC и сверён с PDF издателя. Подзаголовки добавлены для навигации; редакционные пояснения отделены от перевода.

source.rights_note: Full attribution, free-source link and nonendorsement notice supplied. Publisher PDF bytes preserved. Translation and editorial explanations identified separately; no CDC logo introduced.
source.status_check: Publisher page has no correction notice; Crossref has no update-to relation. Full publisher HTML and two-page original PDF reviewed.

selection.reader: Food safety, HACCP, laboratory and technology staff responsible for batch preparation, delivery and catering.
selection.utility: Shows how epidemiology, stool and leftover-food testing, and the preparation/transport history jointly supported a C. perfringens outbreak investigation.
selection.limits: Historical North Carolina outbreak in November 2015, source published November 25, 2016. Survey exposure combines turkey and stuffing. Forty-four exposed respondents and forty-four total cases are separate denominators. CPE toxin detection in stool differs from culture of cpe-bearing bacteria in turkey. Actual holding/transport temperatures were not measured. No universal safe holding limit or reheating regimen inferred; historical local rules are not presented as current Russian law.

review.arithmetic: Exposed 38/44 versus unexposed 6/14; RR rounds to 2.02; 58 respondents and 44 cases consistent. Reported whole-number percentages consistent with ordinary rounding.
review.spelled_numbers: Five stool samples; 20 food submissions; selected food culture/count samples one stuffing plus four turkey, additionally one ham; all five stools CPE-positive and cpe-bearing C. perfringens isolated from five stools/four turkey; one turkey sample >10^5 CFU/g. Ten-hour preparation and up-to-eight-hour holding/transport preserved.
review.pdf_visual_review: All four pages inspected. All source paragraphs, author information and references retained; editorial notes and attribution legible.

typesafe.mode: Additional coverage; full source comparison retained. No efficiency claim.
typesafe.result: All four preserved; deliberately overstated negative control correctly flagged. Decisions assessed against source manually.
